references.text: Israel's laws regarding the treatment of slaves demonstrate God's care for the oppressed and their rights
The command to treat foreigners well and not oppress them, paralleling the protection of runaway slaves
Laws ensuring humane conditions for slaves in Israel, reflecting God's concern for the vulnerable
David promises not to hand over the Egyptian slave who had fled from his master
Job speaks about treating his servants justly, in line with the principle of protecting the oppressed
Paul urges Philemon to welcome the runaway slave Onesimus with kindness instead of punishing him
